metadata.description: KS (PBE) and G0W0 (PPA) quasiparticle band structures on the path Gamma-M-K-Gamma. KS bands: pw.x bands run (181 k points, the path of dft_bands.json). QP bands: QP corrections dE = E_QP - E_KS computed on the whole IBZ of the 18x18x1 grid, interpolated on the path by ypp (BOLTZ, CIRCUIT_E_DB_path) and added to the KS bands. grid_points_on_path: exact yambo energies at the 17 IBZ points of the grid that lie on the path. Interpolation accuracy: exact at the grid points (within 4 meV), smooth for the valence bands; for the conduction bands dE jumps between pi* and nearly-free-electron states at the band crossings and the interpolation can be off by 0.2-0.3 eV between grid points near the crossings.
metadata.units: path coordinate in 2pi/a; energies in eV, zero at the KS VBM of the 18x18x1 grid (at K; the path VBM of AA1 lies 29 meV higher, off K), the same zero for KS and QP

BndsRnXp_GbndRnge.note: bilayer bands chosen for the same energy window as the ML

gw_parameters.coulomb: slab cutoff (CUTGeo 'slab z'), RIM (RandQpts 5e6, RandGvec 101 RL), RIM_W (RandGvecW 11 RL)
gw_parameters.exchange: EXXRLvcs = VXCRLvcs = all the density G vectors

metadata.source_runs: MB_analysis/<SAVE folder>/<full-IBZ run>/ndb.QP, ypp_bands_ks, ypp_bands_qp; MB_analysis/bands_path-<system>
